def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x:sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    marks=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg and grid[r][c] not in (2,5,6)]
    # Locate the non-background template component; replicate its shape centered on each marker.
    from collections import Counter, deque
    counts=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    special=[v for v,n in counts.items() if v!=bg and n>1]
    # Most frequent non-background color is the template; singleton color is marker.
    col=max(special, key=lambda v:counts[v])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==col]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts]
    cr=(max(r for r,c in shape)+min(r for r,c in shape))//2
    cc=(max(c for r,c in shape)+min(c for r,c in shape))//2
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]

    for r in range(h):

          for dr,dc in shape:
            rr=r+dr-cr; cc2=c+dc-cc

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter, deque
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); counts=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    bg=max(counts,key=counts.get)
    colors=[v for v in counts if v!=bg]
    # Template color forms a connected multi-cell object; marker color is the remaining color.
    comps=[]
    for color in colors:
        cells={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color}
        unseen=set(cells)
        while unseen:
            seed=unseen.pop(); comp={seed}; q=[seed]
            while q:
                r,c=q.pop()
                for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                    if p in unseen: unseen.remove(p); comp.add(p); q.append(p)
            comps.append((color,comp))
    template_color, shape=max(comps,key=lambda z:len(z[1]))
    marker_color=next(v for v in colors if v!=template_color)
    rs=[r for r,c in shape]; cs=[c for r,c in shape]
    cr=(min(rs)+max(rs))//2; cc=(min(cs)+max(cs))//2
    offsets=[(r-cr,c-cc) for r,c in shape]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]==marker_color:
                for dr,dc in offsets:
                    rr,cc2=r+dr,c+dc
                    if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc2<w: out[rr][cc2]=template_color
    return out
